outcome: administration of blood transfusion in the operating room
cohort: The study included 276 caesarean deliveries performed under general anaesthesia at the University of Tsukuba Hospital between April 2012 and March 2022.
finding: This study found no significant association between the use of volatile anaesthesia and increased intraoperative blood loss or transfusion during caesarean section compared to total intravenous anaesthesia.
mod_finding: No significant difference in intraoperative blood loss or transfusion was observed during caesarean section when comparing volatile and total intravenous anaesthesia.
